_comment: Scene for the politics panel. Renderer keys: 'windows' with 'at' (where the engine puts each top-level window on a 2560x1440 screen; leave it out to use the file's own position until it is measured with render_gui.py --verify), 'rows' and 'listRows' (sample rows per list), 'height', 'hide' and 'place' (what the code sizes, hides or moves in this state); 'samples' (texts for named text boxes). Harness keys: 'setup' (recipe steps from the clean state; see wiki/Game-Recipes.md), 'captures' (extra named captures with their own steps), 'expect' (widgets that must be visible in the capture: proof that the recipe brought the screen up), 'crop' (x, y, width, height cut out of a capture). 'manual' and 'checklist' are what is left for a human.

windows.name: countrypoliticsview
windows._note: The vanilla window with clipping = no, so that the National Figures page docked to politics_tab shows beside it (D4).

checklist: The panel looks as vanilla: portrait, focus, spirits, faction, the ruling party plate, the parties, the three buttons, the idea categories
The Figures button in the title strip opens National Figures beside the panel; Escape closes the panel and the page with it
_note: Overridden since D4 for one line: clipping = no on countrypoliticsview, and the ideology text of ruling_party_info moved (wiki/phases/D4-national-figures.md).
